Subject: Outcome of the Board Meeting - Unaudited financial results for the second 
quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. 
In terms of the provisions of R~gulations 30 (read with Part A Para A of Schedule Ill) and 33 
of the SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, we enclose 
the following statements for the second quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026, 
which were approved and taken on record by the board of directors at its meeting held today 
i.e. on 27 October 2026: 
a) Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the second quarter and 
half year ended 30 September 2026; 
b) Limited Review Reports (separately for Standalone & Consolidated) for the second 
quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026; and 
c) Press Release. 
The meeting commenced at 12.00 noon and concluded at 03.10 p.m.

3 Exceptional items for the year ended 31 March 2026. represent a net charge of 'l' 23.80 crore, comprising 
(i) The Government of India notified the Code on Wages, 2019; Industrial Relations Code, 2020; Code on Social Security, 2020; and Occupational Safely, Health and Worl<ing Conditions Code, 2020 (collectively, 
'labour Codes') on 21 November 2025. Based on the revised def,nitiion of wages under the labour Codes, the Company recognized net charge of ? 58.33 crore on account of impact of Labour Codes. Deferred Tax 
Asset recognised for this exceptiional item of expenditure was < 15.43 crore. 
(ii) gain of< 34.53 crore on prepayment of deferral incentive/loan at net present value (NPV) against a carrying amount of < 56.33 crore. 
4 On 6 May 2026, the Board of Directors of the Company approved a buyback of up to 4,694,000 fully paid-up eouily shares of the Company having face value of ?10/- eacll, at a price of< 12,000 per eouily share, 
payable in cash, for an aggregate amount of up to 'l' 5,632.80 crore excluding transaction costs, on a proportionate basis, through the ·tender offer route, in accordance with the applicable laws. Further, the 
shareholders of the Company approved the buyback by way of a special resolution, through postal bailot. the results of which were announced on 18 June 2026. The tendering period for the buyback opened on 01 
July 2026 and was closed on 07 July 2026 and the Company made payment to all the shareholders whose bids were valid and accepted under the buyback on 14 July 2026, through the stock exchange settlement 
mechanism. In accordance with relevant statutory provisions, the Company has created a capital redemption reserve of f 4.69 crore, eoual to the nominal value of shares bought back, as an appropriation from 
retained earnings. 
The announcement under Regulation 30 of Listing Regulation regarding the completion of extinguishment of 4,694,000 shares and lhe closure of the Buyback was filed with the stock exchanges on 24 July 2026. 
The corresponding report was also submitted to SEBI on 24 July 2026. 
5 The Ministry of Environment, Forest and C6mate Change (MoEFCC) issued the Environment Protcctiion (End-of-Loe Vehicles) Rules, 2025 (ELV rules), effective from 1 April 2025. In accordance with ELV rules, 
Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) obligations are imposed on producers (including ·vehicle manufacturers') for the scrapping of End-of-Life Vehicles. As the pricing mechanism for EPR certificates has not yet 
been notified by MoEFCC, amongst other things, the Company is currently unable to reliably estimate its obligation and believes that it will be able to estimate the same once all the measurement framework for 
determining the reliable estimate is established. 
6 Figures for previous year/ period have been regrouped wherever necessary. 
7 The above results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee, approved by the Board of Directors in the meeting held on 27 October 2026 and were subjected lo a limited review by the statutory auditors.

Hon’ble Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah Visits Bharat Forge's Pune Facility 
- Inaugurates Milestone Plaque to Mark the Company's 60th Anniversary - 
- Flags off consignment of 5.56 x 45 mm rifles for the Uttar Pradesh Special Task Force - 
 
Pune | November 16, 2026: Hon'ble Union Minister of Home Affairs and Minister of Cooperation, 
Government of India, Shri Amit Shah, visited the Kalyani - Bharat Forge facility in Pune, the world's largest 
forging facility, on November 15. He was received by Padma Bhushan Baba Kalyani, Chairman and Managing 
Director, Bharat Forge Ltd. 
The Hon’ble Home Minister inaugurated a milestone plaque to commemorate Bharat Forge's 60th 
Anniversary. The plaque marks six decades of the Company’s journey in engineering excellence, innovation 
and nation building. 
During the visit, he toured the forging lines and interacted with the leadership on the Company’s growth over 
the years. The discussion covered Bharat Forge’s role in strengthening India’s manufacturing and defence 
capabilities, in line with the vision of Aatmanirbhar Bharat and Sashakt Bharat, Surakshit Bharat. 
The Hon’ble Home Minister was also shown the range of indigenously designed and manufactured products, 
including small arms, artillery guns, ammunition systems, unmanned systems in air, land and water - by 
Kalyani Strategic Systems Limited (KSSL), the wholly-owned defence subsidiary of Bharat Forge. These 
products show the company’s contribution to self-reliance in defence manufacturing. 
Hon’ble Home Minister flagged off the first consignment of 5.56 x 45 mm rifles for the Uttar Pradesh Special 
Task Force (UPSTF). 
*** 
About Bharat Forge 
Bharat Forge Limited (BFL), a Pune-based multinational company, is a technology-driven global leader in providing 
innovative, high-performance and safety-critical components and solutions across automotive, aerospace, defence, rail, 
marine, energy and industrial sectors. With a global manufacturing footprint and world-class engineering capabilities, 
BFL is at the forefront of supporting India’s strategic industrial and defence ambitions. 
About Kalyani Strategic Systems Limited 
Kalyani Strategic Systems Limited (KSSL), a wholly owned subsidiary of Bharat Forge Limited, drives the defence business 
of the Kalyani Group, one of the world’s foremost engineering and metallurgical enterprises. With more than six decades 
of expertise in design, engineering, metallurgy and advanced manufacturing, KSSL delivers sovereign defence capability 
across the land, marine and unmanned domains - spanning artillery systems, armoured and protected vehicles, small 
arms, ammunition, and marine and unmanned platforms. Beyond supplying battle-ready systems, KSSL enables partner 
nations to build their own defence industrial base through technology partnership, local industrialisation and assured 
through-life support, backed by proven production at scale and security of supply. Trusted by both Indian and global 
armed forces and governments seeking resilient, self-reliant capability, KSSL is a trusted global defence partner of 
choice. 
Media Contact 
Dimple Raisurana Kapur  |  Group Chief Communications Officer, Kalyani Group 
Email: Dimple.RaisuranaKapur@kalyani.in  |  Mobile: +91 98205 25305

                                                        November 16, 2026 
 
 
BSE Limited

Trading Symbol: HINDZINC 
 
Dear Sir/Ma’am, 
 
Sub: Intimation under Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations 
and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Clause 3 of Para B of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing 
Regulations, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held 
today, i.e., November 16, 2026, approved the HZL 2.0 Growth Program, aimed at increasing the 
Company’s metal production capacity from the existing 1.1 MTPA to 2.0 MTPA, with an envisaged 
capital expenditure of approximately INR 80,000 crore over the next 3–5 years. 
 
The details as required under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations read with SEBI Master 
Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026, are enclosed 
herewith and marked as “Annexure - A”. 
 
The meeting of the Board of Directors commenced at 10.30 AM and concluded at 1:40 PM 
 
Also, please find enclosed herewith the Investor Presentation marked as ‘Annexure - B’.  
 
This intimation is also being uploaded on the Company’s website at https://www.hzlindia.com/. 
 
We request you to kindly take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking You. 
 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Hindustan Zinc Limited 
 
 
 
Aashhima V Khanna 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer 
 
Enclosed as above 
 
 
 
 
 
AASHHIMA 
V KHANNA

Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026, are enclosed

We request you to kindly take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking You.

For Hindustan Zinc Limited

PRESS RELEASE  
  
Biocon Gets U.S. FDA Approval for Pebrilzo™ (pertuzumab-qcay) 
Injection, a Biosimilar to Perjeta®, Expanding Its Oncology Portfolio 
 
• 
Biocon’s PEBRILZO approval represents an important step toward broadening treatment 
option for patients with HER2-positive breast cancer in the United States, subject to the 
anticipated commercial launch timeline 
• 
PEBRILZO further strengthens Biocon’s oncology portfolio, now totaling five biosimilar 
therapies for cancer in the United States 
 
BENGALURU, India and BRIDGEWATER, N.J., United States: November 16, 2026 
 
Biocon Limited (BSE: 532523; NSE: BIOCON), an innovation-led global biopharmaceutical company, 
today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Pebrilzo™ 
(pertuzumab-qcay), a biosimilar of the reference product Perjeta® (pertuzumab). PEBRILZO is a 
monoclonal antibody used to treat HER2-positive breast cancer by blocking HER2 receptors on cancer 
cells. The FDA approval further strengthens Biocon’s oncology portfolio. 
 
Shreehas Tambe, CEO & Managing Director, Biocon Limited, said, “The U.S. FDA approval of 
PEBRILZO, our biosimilar pertuzumab, marks another significant milestone in Biocon’s journey to 
expand access to high-quality biosimilars. For patients diagnosed with HER2-positive breast cancer, 
the burden of the disease extends well beyond the physical challenges, often placing considerable 
financial strain on patients and their families. As our fifth oncology biosimilar to receive U.S. FDA 
approval, PEBRILZO strengthens our anti-cancer portfolio and advances our commitment to expanding 
access to high-quality, affordable biologic medicines.” 
 
In September, the European Medicines Agency’s Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use 
(CHMP) had given a positive opinion recommending the granting of a marketing authorization for 
Biocon’s Pertuzumab biosimilar as 420 mg/14 mL concentrate solution for infusion, under the brand 
name Pebrilzo®, for the treatment of HER2-positive breast cancer across multiple disease stages in 
Europe. 
 
Biocon also announced a global settlement and license agreement with Genentech securing the 
earliest licensed launch date for PEBRILZO in the United States in Q3 of calendar year 2028. 
 
Biocon’s Oncology Portfolio and Pipeline:  
Biocon’s oncology strategy combines an established portfolio with continued development across 
additional treatment approaches. PEBRILZO will join its robust portfolio of oncology therapies, which 
includes Ogivri® (trastuzumab-dkst), Jobevne® (bevacizumab-nwgd), Fulphila® (pegfilgrastim-jmdb), 
and Aukelso® (denosumab-kyqq). Building on this foundation, Biocon’s growing oncology pipeline 
includes proposed biosimilars to trastuzumab/hyaluronidase, nivolumab and pembrolizumab, 
spanning HER2-directed therapy and immuno-oncology. 
 
About HER2-Positive Breast Cancer: 
HER2-positive breast cancer is a subtype of breast cancer characterized by HER2 protein 
overexpression and/or HER2 gene amplification, which drives aggressive tumor growth. 
 

 
2 
 
Approximately 320,000 women in the United States are expected to be diagnosed with breast cancer in 
2026.1 Of those diagnoses, about 20% will be HER2-positive breast cancer2. On a broader scale, 1 in 8 
women are expected to be diagnosed with breast cancer during her lifetime, highlighting the ongoing 
need for treatment options in this area3. 
 
About PEBRILZO (pertuzumab-qcay) 
The approval for PEBRILZO (pertuzumab-qcay) was based on a comprehensive package containing 
structural and functional analytical characterization, analytical similarity, and comparative clinical 
pharmacokinetic data, which confirmed that PEBRILZO is highly similar to the reference biologics, 
Perjeta® with no clinically meaningful differences in quality, safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity. 
 
WARNING 
LEFT VENTRICULAR DYSFUNCTION and EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY 
• 
Left Ventricular Dysfunction: PEBRILZO can cause subclinical and clinical cardiac failure 
manifesting as decreased LVEF and CHF. Evaluate cardiac function prior to and during 
treatment. Discontinue PEBRILZO treatment for a confirmed clinically significant decrease 
in left ventricular function.  
• 
Embryo-fetal Toxicity: Exposure to PEBRILZO can cause embryo-fetal death and birth 
defects. Advise patients of these risks and the need for effective contraception.  
 
INDICATIONS 
PEBRILZO is a HER2/neu receptor antagonist indicated for: 
• 
Metastatic Breast Cancer (MBC): PEBRILZO is indicated for use in combination with 
trastuzumab and docetaxel for the treatment of adults with HER2-positive metastatic breast 
cancer who have not received prior anti-HER2 therapy or chemotherapy for metastatic disease. 
• 
Early Breast Cancer (EBC): PEBRILZO is indicated for use in combination with trastuzumab 
and chemotherapy for: 
o the neoadjuvant treatment of adults with HER2-positive, locally advanced, 
inflammatory, or early-stage breast cancer (either greater than 2 cm in diameter or node 
positive) as part of a complete treatment regimen for early breast cancer.  
o the adjuvant treatment of adults with HER2-positive early breast cancer at high risk of 
recurrence. 
 
CONTRAINDICATIONS 
PEBRILZO is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to pertuzumab or to any of its 
excipients. 
 
WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS 
Left Ventricular Dysfunction 
• 
Pertuzumab can cause left ventricular dysfunction, including symptomatic heart failure. 
Decreases in LVEF have been reported with drugs that block HER2 activity, including PEBRILZO. 
• 
Assess LVEF prior to initiation of PEBRILZO and at regular intervals during treatment to ensure 
that LVEF is within normal limits. If the LVEF declines and has not improved, or has declined 
further at the subsequent assessment, consider permanent discontinuation of PEBRILZO and 
trastuzumab. 
• 
In the pertuzumab-treated patients with MBC in CLEOPATRA, left ventricular dysfunction 
occurred in 4% of patients and symptomatic left ventricular systolic dysfunction (LVSD) 
(congestive heart failure) occurred in 1% of patients. Patients who received prior anthracyclines

or prior radiotherapy to the chest area may be at higher risk of decreased LVEF or left ventricular 
dysfunction. 
• 
In patients receiving pertuzumab as a neoadjuvant treatment in combination with trastuzumab 
and docetaxel in NeoSphere, LVEF decline > 10% and a drop to < 50% occurred in 8% of 
patients and left ventricular dysfunction occurred in 3% of patients. LVEF recovered to ≥ 50% in 
all these patients. 
• 
In patients receiving neoadjuvant pertuzumab in TRYPHAENA, LVEF decline > 10% and a drop to 
< 50% occurred in 7% of patients treated with pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and FEC followed 
by pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and docetaxel, 16% of patients treated with pertuzumab plus 
trastuzumab and docetaxel following FEC, and 11% of patients treated with pertuzumab in 
combination with TCH. Left ventricular dysfunction occurred in 6% of patients treated with 
pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and FEC followed by pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and 
docetaxel, 4% of patients treated with pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and docetaxel following 
FEC, and 3% of patients treated with pertuzumab in combination with TCH. Symptomatic LVSD 
occurred in 4% of patients treated with pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and docetaxel following 
FEC, 1% of patients treated with pertuzumab in combination with TCH, and none of the patients 
treated with pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and FEC followed by pertuzumab plus trastuzumab 
and docetaxel. LVEF recovered to ≥ 50% in all but one patient. 
• 
In patients receiving neoadjuvant pertuzumab in BERENICE, in the neoadjuvant period, LVEF 
decline ≥ 10% and a drop to < 50% as measured by ECHO/MUGA assessment occurred in 7% of 
patients treated with pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and paclitaxel following ddAC, and 2% of 
patients treated with pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and docetaxel following FEC. Ejection 
fraction decreased (asymptomatic LVD) occurred in 7% of patients treated with pertuzumab 
plus trastuzumab and paclitaxel following ddAC and 4% of the patients treated with 
pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and docetaxel following FEC in the neoadjuvant period. 
Symptomatic LVSD (NYHA Class III/IV Congestive Heart Failure) occurred in 2% of patients 
treated with pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and paclitaxel following ddAC and none of the 
patients treated with pertuzumab plus trastuzumab and docetaxel following FEC in the 
neoadjuvant period. 
• 
In patients receiving adjuvant pertuzumab in APHINITY, the incidence of symptomatic heart 
failure (NYHA Class III/IV) with a LVEF decline ≥ 10% and a drop to < 50% was 0.6%. Of the 
patients who experienced symptomatic heart failure, 47% of pertuzumab-treated patients had 
recovered (defined as 2 consecutive LVEF measurements above 50%) at the data cutoff. The 
majority of the events (86%) were reported in anthracycline-treated patients. Asymptomatic or 
mildly symptomatic (NYHA Class II) declines in LVEF ≥ 10% and a drop to < 50% were reported 
in 3% of pertuzumab-treated patients, of whom 80% recovered at the data cutoff. 
• 
Pertuzumab has not been studied in patients with a pretreatment LVEF value of < 50%, a prior 
history of CHF, decreases in LVEF to < 50% during prior trastuzumab therapy, or conditions that 
could impair left ventricular function such as uncontrolled hypertension, recent myocardial 
infarction, serious cardiac arrhythmia requiring treatment or a cumulative prior anthracycline 
exposure to > 360 mg/m2 of doxorubicin or its equivalent. 
 
Embryo-Fetal Toxicity 
• 
Based on its mechanism of action and findings in animal studies, pertuzumab can cause fetal 
harm when administered to a pregnant woman. Pertuzumab is a HER2/neu receptor antagonist. 
Cases of oligohydramnios and oligohydramnios sequence manifesting as pulmonary 
hypoplasia, skeletal abnormalities, and neonatal death have been reported with use of another 
HER2/neu receptor antagonist (trastuzumab) during pregnancy. In an animal reproduction 
study, administration of pertuzumab to pregnant cynomolgus monkeys during the period of 
organogenesis resulted in oligohydramnios, delayed fetal kidney development, and embryo-

 
4 
 
fetal death at exposures 2.5 to 20 times the exposure in humans at the recommended dose, 
based on Cmax. 
 
Infusion-Related Reactions 
• 
Pertuzumab can cause serious infusion reactions, including fatal events.

PRESS RELEASE  
  
Biocon Gets U.S. FDA Approval for Pebrilzo™ (pertuzumab-qcay) 
Injection, a Biosimilar to Perjeta®, Expanding Its Oncology Portfolio 
 
• 
Biocon’s PEBRILZO approval represents an important step toward broadening treatment 
option for patients with HER2-positive breast cancer in the United States, subject to the 
anticipated commercial launch timeline 
• 
PEBRILZO further strengthens Biocon’s oncology portfolio, now totaling five biosimilar 
therapies for cancer in the United States 
 
BENGALURU, India and BRIDGEWATER, N.J., United States: November 16, 2026 
 
Biocon Limited (BSE: 532523; NSE: BIOCON), an innovation-led global biopharmaceutical company, 
today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Pebrilzo™ 
(pertuzumab-qcay), a biosimilar of the reference product Perjeta® (pertuzumab). PEBRILZO is a 
monoclonal antibody used to treat HER2-positive breast cancer by blocking HER2 receptors on cancer 
cells. The FDA approval further strengthens Biocon’s oncology portfolio. 
 
Shreehas Tambe, CEO & Managing Director, Biocon Limited, said, “The U.S. FDA approval of 
PEBRILZO, our biosimilar pertuzumab, marks another significant milestone in Biocon’s journey to 
expand access to high-quality biosimilars. For patients diagnosed with HER2-positive breast cancer, 
the burden of the disease extends well beyond the physical challenges, often placing considerable 
financial strain on patients and their families. As our fifth oncology biosimilar to receive U.S. FDA 
approval, PEBRILZO strengthens our anti-cancer portfolio and advances our commitment to expanding 
access to high-quality, affordable biologic medicines.” 
 
In September, the European Medicines Agency’s Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use 
(CHMP) had given a positive opinion recommending the granting of a marketing authorization for 
Biocon’s Pertuzumab biosimilar as 420 mg/14 mL concentrate solution for infusion, under the brand 
name Pebrilzo®, for the treatment of HER2-positive breast cancer across multiple disease stages in 
Europe. 
 
Biocon also announced a global settlement and license agreement with Genentech securing the 
earliest licensed launch date for PEBRILZO in the United States in Q3 of calendar year 2028. 
 
Biocon’s Oncology Portfolio and Pipeline:  
Biocon’s oncology strategy combines an established portfolio with continued development across 
additional treatment approaches. PEBRILZO will join its robust portfolio of oncology therapies, which 
includes Ogivri® (trastuzumab-dkst), Jobevne® (bevacizumab-nwgd), Fulphila® (pegfilgrastim-jmdb), 
and Aukelso® (denosumab-kyqq). Building on this foundation, Biocon’s growing oncology pipeline 
includes proposed biosimilars to trastuzumab/hyaluronidase, nivolumab and pembrolizumab, 
spanning HER2-directed therapy and immuno-oncology. 
 
About HER2-Positive Breast Cancer: 
HER2-positive breast cancer is a subtype of breast cancer characterized by HER2 protein 
overexpression and/or HER2 gene amplification, which drives aggressive tumor growth. 
 

 
2 
 
Approximately 320,000 women in the United States are expected to be diagnosed with breast cancer in 
2026.1 Of those diagnoses, about 20% will be HER2-positive breast cancer2. On a broader scale, 1 in 8 
women are expected to be diagnosed with breast cancer during her lifetime, highlighting the ongoing 
need for treatment options in this area3. 
 
About PEBRILZO (pertuzumab-qcay) 
The approval for PEBRILZO (pertuzumab-qcay) was based on a comprehensive package containing 
structural and functional analytical characterization, analytical similarity, and comparative clinical 
pharmacokinetic data, which confirmed that PEBRILZO is highly similar to the reference biologics, 
Perjeta® with no clinically meaningful differences in quality, safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity.

LEFT VENTRICULAR DYSFUNCTION and EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY

manifesting as decreased LVEF and CHF. Evaluate cardiac function prior to and during 
treatment. Discontinue PEBRILZO treatment for a confirmed clinically significant decrease 
in left ventricular function.  
• 
Embryo-fetal Toxicity: Exposure to PEBRILZO can cause embryo-fetal death and birth 
defects. Advise patients of these risks and the need for effective contraception.

PEBRILZO is a HER2/neu receptor antagonist indicated for: 
• 
Metastatic Breast Cancer (MBC): PEBRILZO is indicated for use in combination with 
trastuzumab and docetaxel for the treatment of adults with HER2-positive metastatic breast 
cancer who have not received prior anti-HER2 therapy or chemotherapy for metastatic disease. 
• 
Early Breast Cancer (EBC): PEBRILZO is indicated for use in combination with trastuzumab 
and chemotherapy for: 
o the neoadjuvant treatment of adults with HER2-positive, locally advanced, 
inflammatory, or early-stage breast cancer (either greater than 2 cm in diameter or node 
positive) as part of a complete treatment regimen for early breast cancer.  
o the adjuvant treatment of adults with HER2-positive early breast cancer at high risk of 
recurrence.

PEBRILZO is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to pertuzumab or to any of its 
excipients.

that LVEF is within normal limits. If the LVEF declines and has not improved, or has declined 
further at the subsequent assessment, consider permanent discontinuation of PEBRILZO and 
trastuzumab. 
• 
In the pertuzumab-treated patients with MBC in CLEOPATRA, left ventricular dysfunction 
occurred in 4% of patients and symptomatic left ventricular systolic dysfunction (LVSD) 
(congestive heart failure) occurred in 1% of patients. Patients who received prior anthracyclines

PRESS RELEASE 
 
KPIL SECURES NEW ORDER OF ₹ 2,610 CRORES 
 
Mumbai | Monday, 16 November 2026: Kalpataru Projects International Limited (KPIL), one of the leading 
engineering and construction players in the power and infrastructure sector, has secured notification of 
award for a prestigious order worth approximately ₹2,610 crores. 
 
The details of the aforesaid new order are as follows: 
 
EPC project involving power transmission lines and substations in international market 
 
 
Manish Mohnot, MD & CEO, KPIL, said, “We are pleased to secure this prestigious order in our Power 
Transmission & Distribution (T&D) business, further strengthening our presence in South America and 
reinforcing our growing international footprint. This win marks another significant milestone in our global 
growth journey and reflects our strong execution capabilities, established market presence and the 
increasing demand for strengthening power grid infrastructure worldwide. 
Our order momentum continues to remain strong, with YTD FY27 order inflows exceeding ₹26,000 crore, 
registering a growth of over 50% year-on-year. In addition, we are favourably positioned for projects worth 
approximately ₹3,000 crore and have a robust tender pipeline over the coming months, primarily across 
T&D, Buildings & Factories (B&F) and Oil & Gas. With a strong business visibility, diversified market 
presence and proven execution capabilities, we remain confident of sustaining our growth momentum and 
strengthening our market position going forward.”

About Kalpataru Projects International Limited (KPIL) 
Kalpataru Projects International Limited (KPIL) is one of the largest engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) companies in the 
world, with a global footprint spanning 75 countries. KPIL offers integrated EPC solutions across diverse sectors, including power 
transmission and distribution, buildings and factories, water supply and treatment, railways, oil and gas infrastructure, urban mobility, 
highways, and airports. 
With a legacy of over four decades, KPIL has maintained a leadership position in all its major business verticals. This success is backed by 
strong organizational capabilities, superior technical expertise, and a strict adherence to best-in-class sustainability standards. The 
company operates two manufacturing facilities in India for the fabrication of power transmission towers, heavy metal structures, and 
scaffolding and formwork systems. In FY2026, KPIL generated a revenue of ₹27,143 crores (~USD 2.9 billion), with more than 250 projects 
under execution across over 30 countries.

Moderator: 
Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. Thank you for standing by. Welcome to The Great Eastern 
Shipping Company Limited Earnings Call on declaration of its Financial Results for the Quarter 
Ended 30th September 2026. At this moment, all participants are in listen-only mode. Later, we 
will conduct a question-and-answer session. 
 
I now hand the conference over to Mr. Shivakumar, Executive Director and CFO at The Great 
Eastern Shipping Company Limited. Thank you, and over to you, sir. 
G. Shivakumar: 
Thank you. Good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for attending this conference call, this 
quarterly conference call. We have kept it a couple of days later than usual because we were told 
that a lot of people will be out for the long Diwali weekend. So you would have had time to take 
a look at our results and our presentation as well. 
 
Nevertheless, I will take you through the presentation quickly, and then we can jump straight 
into Q&A. Standard disclaimers apply. Another very profitable quarter, slightly lower than the 
previous immediately preceding quarter, but second highest in historical terms. 
 
The NAV is at its highest ever, and the interim dividend has been maintained at the previous 
quarter's level of INR14.40 per share for this quarter. I will not go too much into these numbers. 
Let us look at what the markets have done. 
 
First of all, looking at the Suezmax earnings, the one caveat I will put, while it shows earnings 
spiking to between $600,000 and $700,000 a day, you need to keep in mind here that this 
includes some routes that get a huge risk premium, because they involve physical danger to the 
ships, their cargoes, and their crews. 
 
There are two specific routes. One is loading from inside the Strait of Hormuz, that is loading 
from either Iraq or Ras Tanura, or from Abu Dhabi. The second is loading from the Black Sea 
port of Novorossiysk, which again has seen several attacks from Ukraine. This is a Russian port 
where oil is loaded. 
 
While the oil itself is not sanctioned because it is not Russian oil, it is Kazakh oil, but a lot of 
ships have been attacked while waiting to load at Novorossiysk or after they have loaded there. 
So, those two loading areas get a huge premium, which of course we do not participate in, and 
therefore, that number has spiked because of the big premium which is attached to those loading 
areas. 
 
Without those, the average Suezmax earnings would probably have maxed out at about 
$350,000-$400,000 a day on the spot market. This was about a month ago, maybe in very late 
September or early October, when Suezmaxes were at those levels. 
 
In the last 10-12 days, rates have dropped off very significantly for crude tankers, specifically 
for Aframaxes and Suezmaxes. Suezmaxes, the rates that we are talking about, $350,000-
$400,000 at the peak month ago, are currently at about $130,000-$150,000 a day. 

 
 
The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited 
 
 
November 11, 2026 
 
Page 3 of 25 
 
 
Still very high numbers in historical terms and even in comparison with last year, but they have 
come off a lot, and every day we see these rates coming off by $15,000, $20,000, $25,000 a day. 
This market action was caused by the renewed traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. 
 
There is now a standard process where there are some ships which are just doing what we call a 
shuttle service. They load inside and come outside. They discharge into another ship, which then 
takes the oil to the ultimate destination. The ships which are doing the shuttle earn a huge 
premium. What happens because of this is that the entire supply chain has become very 
inefficient. 
 
Typically, a Middle East to Far East voyage takes about 45, 46 days on a VLCC. This shuttle 
process, because you have to load twice, you have to discharge twice, the ship is loading inside, 
coming outside, then offloading to another ship, and that adds eight to nine days on average to 
the voyage time, which is an 18%, 20% reduction in efficiency. 
 
And that resulted, again, when efficiency gets reduced, the market becomes tighter, and therefore 
rates spike. That is what we saw last quarter, which is, this happened in August, September, and 
up to early October. 
 
Product tankers took some more time to react, so now they are at an MR tanker is probably 
around $50,000 to $60,000 a day, where we had, again, we had a shortage of diesel, we had 
diesel crack spreads going up a lot, and therefore this trade continues to be reasonably strong.  
 
It has not yet faced the kind of correction that we saw in the Suezmaxes and Aframaxes. Looking 
at the order book, the order book is pretty high for crude tankers. It is about 22% for the product 
tankers. 
 
On dry bulk, it has been nowhere near as exciting as in the case of the tankers, but it still has 
been at profitable levels. Coal trade has grown a little bit. The iron ore trade has grown. Bauxite 
continues to be strong. 
 
Therefore, the ships continue to be earning at reasonably profitable levels. Capesizes, which 
were at around 40,000 in September, have now come down to the 30,000-ish level, 30,000-
35,000 level. So, it has come off a little bit, but again, higher than it was in the previous year. 
 
The prices across the board have gone up, so bulk carrier prices are probably up 5% to 10% 
during the quarter. Tanker prices for the large crude tankers, the Suezmaxes, it has probably 
gone up 50% in the last quarter, which is reflected in our net asset value. 
 
For the smaller tankers, probably between 5% and 20%, depending on the vintage of the fleet. 
Coming to LPG. LPG, of course, all of our ships are on time charter, but these are the spot rates. 
The spot rates have been exceptionally strong, again, because of the disruption. 
 
Basically, the LPG is not coming out so much through the Strait of Hormuz, and this is being 
sourced from the U.S., which is, of course, a much longer ton-mile, and this has led to a tightness 
in the fleet. 

 
 
The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited 
 
 
November 11, 2026 
 
Page 4 of 25 
 
 
So, we are seeing spot rates at about $140,000 a day in H1, versus $55,000 in the same period 
the previous year. Again, I must emphasize, our ships are all on time charter, fixed rate time 
charters, except for one, which has a profit share built into it. I mentioned already on asset price 
movements, you can see that almost vertical line in crude tankers, and you can see everything 
else is moving up quite gradually. LPG also saw a big spike. 
 
The order book continues to be solid. LPG orderbook is now almost 40% of the fleet. The order 
book is almost 40%. As I said, crude tankers, 28%, product tankers, 22%, and dry bulk also 
starting to pick up. So, we are now at almost 16% of the existing fleet. 
 
This is year-wise. We won't go too much into it. Scrapping, of course, logically, you would not 
be scrapping ships when earnings are so high. So, earnings have kept scrapping to very minimal 
levels. Typically, the tankers which have been scrapped tend to be those which have been 
sanctioned and are very old, and therefore, because they don't have an opportunity to trade and 
take advantage of these markets, they just opt to scrap the ships. 
 
Coming to the offshore business, jack-up market utilization remains quite decent. Of course, 
there is some turmoil in the Middle East about contract suspensions, rigs put on standby, etcetera, 
but not much change in the jack-up utilization. Won't go into this. This is a standard slide on the 
age of the fleet. We have repricings. Here, we have a couple of updates.  
We have got two contracts in India, 3-year contracts for two of our rigs. So those now show on 
the extreme right of this graph, as the two rigs which next need repricing in H2 FY30. These 
two rigs will go onto their contracts in the next 6 months and will be employed all the way up to 
FY30. 
So we only have one rig left now for which we need to find employment. Apart from that, we 
also have eight vessels which are up for repricing. Four of these have been bid into tenders in 
India. We await the outcome of those tenders. These are general overviews. I will just. We have 
added, in the last quarter, we only did two transactions.  
One is we sold our 2009-built LR2 tanker, Jag Lokesh. We replaced with a more modern LR2 
tanker, Jag Laxman. So that is a transaction which was done in July, a set of transactions which 
was done in July. After that, we have added two vessels in the last week. That's one Kamsarmax, 
the Jag Amit, which is 2015 built and the Jag Vikrant, which is a very large gas carrier, which 
is also 2015 built.  
The Jag Vikrant comes with a charter attached, so she's on a fixed rate contract for almost 3 
years. This goes up to around September 2029. Again, she will not be participating in the current 
spot market. She has no pricing points for the next almost 3 years. Apart from this, we have two 
more vessels where we've committed.  
We have a Kamsarmax bulk carrier, which, again, will be delivered to us within this month or 
the next month. This is a 2019-built bulk carrier. And we have a new building Suezmax tanker,

which will come to us in about 2 years' time, a little over two years time. You can see what 
happened here.  
Just focus on the TCYs. You can see what happened here between Q1 and Q2 and why the 
shipping profitability came down a bit. We had average TCY of about USD93,000 a day for 
crude carriers in Q1, which came down to about USD73,000. The big impact was felt by the

G. Shivakumar: 
Yes.

Rajesh Jain: 
What was your thought process in not fixing more ships on time charter for longer duration, 
even if it was 20%, 25% below the spot rate? 
G. Shivakumar: 
Okay. Unfortunately, the rates that were available, it is a good question. The rates that are 
available in the time charter market were at a very, very big discount to the spot rates. So, for 
instance, when rates were at USD300,000 a day in the spot market for a Suezmax, the 2-year 
time charter rate was probably around USD60,000 or max USD70,000 a day. 
So, the discount you have to take to fix on time charter is 60% to 70% at least. So, it was not 
available at a 20% discount to the spot rates. That only happens in weak markets, where you will 
get closer to a 20% discount, not a weak market. You will get it in a market which is normal

Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. Thank you for standing by. Welcome to The Great Eastern 
Shipping Company Limited Earnings Call on declaration of its Financial Results for the Quarter 
Ended 30th September 2026. At this moment, all participants are in listen-only mode. Later, we 
will conduct a question-and-answer session. 
 
I now hand the conference over to Mr. Shivakumar, Executive Director and CFO at The Great 
Eastern Shipping Company Limited. Thank you, and over to you, sir. 
G. Shivakumar: 
Thank you. Good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for attending this conference call, this 
quarterly conference call. We have kept it a couple of days later than usual because we were told 
that a lot of people will be out for the long Diwali weekend. So you would have had time to take 
a look at our results and our presentation as well. 
 
Nevertheless, I will take you through the presentation quickly, and then we can jump straight 
into Q&A. Standard disclaimers apply. Another very profitable quarter, slightly lower than the 
previous immediately preceding quarter, but second highest in historical terms. 
 
The NAV is at its highest ever, and the interim dividend has been maintained at the previous 
quarter's level of INR14.40 per share for this quarter. I will not go too much into these numbers. 
Let us look at what the markets have done. 
 
First of all, looking at the Suezmax earnings, the one caveat I will put, while it shows earnings 
spiking to between $600,000 and $700,000 a day, you need to keep in mind here that this 
includes some routes that get a huge risk premium, because they involve physical danger to the 
ships, their cargoes, and their crews. 
 
There are two specific routes. One is loading from inside the Strait of Hormuz, that is loading 
from either Iraq or Ras Tanura, or from Abu Dhabi. The second is loading from the Black Sea 
port of Novorossiysk, which again has seen several attacks from Ukraine. This is a Russian port 
where oil is loaded. 
 
While the oil itself is not sanctioned because it is not Russian oil, it is Kazakh oil, but a lot of 
ships have been attacked while waiting to load at Novorossiysk or after they have loaded there. 
So, those two loading areas get a huge premium, which of course we do not participate in, and 
therefore, that number has spiked because of the big premium which is attached to those loading 
areas. 
 
Without those, the average Suezmax earnings would probably have maxed out at about 
$350,000-$400,000 a day on the spot market. This was about a month ago, maybe in very late 
September or early October, when Suezmaxes were at those levels. 
 
In the last 10-12 days, rates have dropped off very significantly for crude tankers, specifically 
for Aframaxes and Suezmaxes. Suezmaxes, the rates that we are talking about, $350,000-
$400,000 at the peak month ago, are currently at about $130,000-$150,000 a day. 

 
 
The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited 
 
 
November 11, 2026 
 
Page 3 of 25 
 
 
Still very high numbers in historical terms and even in comparison with last year, but they have 
come off a lot, and every day we see these rates coming off by $15,000, $20,000, $25,000 a day. 
This market action was caused by the renewed traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. 
 
There is now a standard process where there are some ships which are just doing what we call a 
shuttle service. They load inside and come outside. They discharge into another ship, which then 
takes the oil to the ultimate destination. The ships which are doing the shuttle earn a huge 
premium. What happens because of this is that the entire supply chain has become very 
inefficient. 
 
Typically, a Middle East to Far East voyage takes about 45, 46 days on a VLCC. This shuttle 
process, because you have to load twice, you have to discharge twice, the ship is loading inside, 
coming outside, then offloading to another ship, and that adds eight to nine days on average to 
the voyage time, which is an 18%, 20% reduction in efficiency. 
 
And that resulted, again, when efficiency gets reduced, the market becomes tighter, and therefore 
rates spike. That is what we saw last quarter, which is, this happened in August, September, and 
up to early October. 
 
Product tankers took some more time to react, so now they are at an MR tanker is probably 
around $50,000 to $60,000 a day, where we had, again, we had a shortage of diesel, we had 
diesel crack spreads going up a lot, and therefore this trade continues to be reasonably strong.  
 
It has not yet faced the kind of correction that we saw in the Suezmaxes and Aframaxes. Looking 
at the order book, the order book is pretty high for crude tankers. It is about 22% for the product 
tankers. 
 
On dry bulk, it has been nowhere near as exciting as in the case of the tankers, but it still has 
been at profitable levels. Coal trade has grown a little bit. The iron ore trade has grown. Bauxite 
continues to be strong. 
 
Therefore, the ships continue to be earning at reasonably profitable levels. Capesizes, which 
were at around 40,000 in September, have now come down to the 30,000-ish level, 30,000-
35,000 level. So, it has come off a little bit, but again, higher than it was in the previous year. 
 
The prices across the board have gone up, so bulk carrier prices are probably up 5% to 10% 
during the quarter. Tanker prices for the large crude tankers, the Suezmaxes, it has probably 
gone up 50% in the last quarter, which is reflected in our net asset value. 
 
For the smaller tankers, probably between 5% and 20%, depending on the vintage of the fleet. 
Coming to LPG. LPG, of course, all of our ships are on time charter, but these are the spot rates. 
The spot rates have been exceptionally strong, again, because of the disruption. 
 
Basically, the LPG is not coming out so much through the Strait of Hormuz, and this is being 
sourced from the U.S., which is, of course, a much longer ton-mile, and this has led to a tightness 
in the fleet. 

 
 
The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited 
 
 
November 11, 2026 
 
Page 4 of 25 
 
 
So, we are seeing spot rates at about $140,000 a day in H1, versus $55,000 in the same period 
the previous year. Again, I must emphasize, our ships are all on time charter, fixed rate time 
charters, except for one, which has a profit share built into it. I mentioned already on asset price 
movements, you can see that almost vertical line in crude tankers, and you can see everything 
else is moving up quite gradually. LPG also saw a big spike. 
 
The order book continues to be solid. LPG orderbook is now almost 40% of the fleet. The order

starting to pick up. So, we are now at almost 16% of the existing fleet.

Good evening and welcome, everyone, to this Earnings Call post announcement of Q2 
and H1 FY2027 Results of VA TECH WABAG LIMITED. On the call today from the 
management team, we have Mr. Rajiv Mittal, Chairman and Managing Director, Mr. 
Bhupesh Chowdary Nagineni, Deputy Managing Director, and Mr. Skandaprasad 
Seetharaman, Group Chief Financial Officer. 
 
Kindly note that during this call, the Company may make certain forward-looking 
statements concerning the business prospects and profitability, which may be subject 
to risks and uncertainties, and the actual results could materially differ from those in 
such forward-looking statements. The conference call will be archived, and a transcript 
will be made available on the Company's website. 
 
The Company's results update presentation has been uploaded on the website and stock 
exchanges, which provides an overview about the core offerings and analysis of the 
results of this period. We trust that you had the opportunity to look through the same. 
 
I will now request Mr. Rajiv Mittal to take you through the key business highlights. 
Thank you, and over to you. 
Rajiv Mittal: 
Thank you. Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. A very warm welcome to everyone 
on this earning call following the Q2 & H1 FY2027 result announcement of VA TECH 
WABAG LIMITED. I would like to thank our investors, analysts, and other 
stakeholders for their continued interest, confidence, and support in WABAG. We very 
truly appreciate your presence this evening. 
 
Joining me today on the call is Mr. Bhupesh Chowdary, our DMD, and Mr. 
Skandaprasad Seetharaman, our Group CFO. I am pleased to share that the first half 
of FY2027 has been a standout period in WABAG's growth journey, marked by 
significant strategic development, robust order intake, healthy execution, and 
continued improvement in our financial performance. We have achieved two distinct 
milestones in Company's history during this period. 
 
The first time ever, our order book has surpassed INR 20,000 crores, while our net 
cash position has surpassed INR 1,000 crores, achieving record levels in both 
parameters. These milestones reflect the progress we have made over the years in 
strengthening our business model, enhancing our execution capabilities, and 
maintaining financial discipline. Our growth has been supported by a combination of 
international expansion, repeat orders from established customers, technology-led 
projects, and continued focus on profitable and cash-generative opportunities. 
 
During this current financial year, we have made a maiden entry into Kuwait, 
established our presence in UAE, secured significant orders from Reliance Industries 

 
                                                                                                       VA TECH WABAG LIMITED 
 
 
November 06, 2026 
 
Page 3 of 19 
 
Limited, and expanded our presence in Europe. Importantly, this strong order 
momentum has been accompanied by healthy revenue growth, improving profitability, 
and further strengthening of our balance sheet. We believe that the combination of 
robust order book, strong liquidity, and expanding international footprint places 
WABAG in a favourable position to pursue the next phase of growth.  
Let me now briefly touch upon some of the key developments during this period. The 
major takeaway during this period from an order win perspective was securing two 
Mega orders from two different clusters.  
 
During H1, we signed and commenced the contract with the Ministry of Electricity, 
Water and Renewable Energy, Kuwait in partnership with HEISCO for a 60 MIGD or 
approximately 272 million liters per day of seawater reverse osmosis desalination 
facility. This project also comes with the five-year operation and maintenance post-
completion of EPC phase. This maiden project gives us an important foothold in the 
market where water security is strategic important and builds on our wider GCC track 
record. Our entry into Kuwait is validation of significant progress which we have made 
in one of our strategic objectives to expand internationally.  
In India, we strengthened our longstanding relationship with Reliance Industries 
Limited, securing a Mega order for desalination plant in Jamnagar with a capacity of 
approximately 201 million liters per day, expandable to approximately 302 million 
liters per day, and also a remineralization plant of approximately 72 million liters per 
day. In September, we had also received a repeat Medium order from Reliance 
Industries Limited for an effluent treatment plant at Dhirubhai Ambani Green Energy 
Giga Complex in Jamnagar. These wins reinforce our position as a technology partner 
for a demanding industry water application and reflects the trust bestowed on us by the 
renowned customer. For O&M, we also signed a contract with one of the largest Indian

Chennai (India), November 16, 2026: Intellect Design Arena Ltd., a global leader in AI-First, 
enterprise-grade financial technology, has won three global titles at the Euromoney Transaction 
Banking Awards 2026: 
 
●​ World’s Best Software Provider for Transaction Banking 
●​ World’s Best Software Provider for Cash Management 
●​ World’s Best Software Provider for Risk Management 
 
The awards were presented at a ceremony held at The Savoy in London. This marks the second 
consecutive year that Intellect has won three World’s Best titles in the programme, with Transaction 
Banking and Cash Management recognised for the second year running, alongside a new recognition for 
Risk Management. 
 
Behind every payment is a promise kept, and behind every trade is a business reaching a new market. 
With eMACH.ai, Intellect brings connected transaction banking capabilities together through a single 
composable platform and CBX engagement layer, enabling banks to progressively modernise their 
operations without replacing their existing core infrastructure. 
 
 
Photo caption: Intellect delegates receiving the awards. 

 
 
 
 
World’s Best Software Provider for Transaction Banking 
eMACH.ai connects a bank’s systems, other banks and third parties to deliver seamless corporate 
journeys across 9 service lines, 12 domain packs and more than 650 ready-to-deploy journeys, serving 
clients from SMEs to large institutions. This translates into measurable improvements in delivery and 
scale: at one leading European bank, corporate client onboarding is 70% faster and new-country 
launches are 65% faster, while Intellect’s supply chain finance platform disbursed more than US$25 
billion across 1.4 million transactions in 2025. 
 
World’s Best Software Provider for Cash Management 
Through CBX and the M-AWARE framework, Intellect gives corporate treasurers a consolidated, real-time 
view of cash across accounts, entities, currencies and banks, enabling them to make informed liquidity 
decisions and manage their cash positions more effectively. Its liquidity engine, estimated to power 23% 
of multinational G7-currency sweeps globally, processes US$30 trillion in automated cash sweeps 
annually, while its virtual accounts capability has been benchmarked at 95 million accounts. 
 
World’s Best Software Provider for Risk Management 
eMACH.ai Transaction Limits Management (TLM) enables banks to make real-time payment decisions by 
checking available funds and credit, settlement and exposure limits in a single pass, returning an 
auditable pay, no-pay or refer decision in under two seconds. At a tier-1 UK bank, TLM delivers 
instant-payment decisions in under 500 milliseconds while maintaining exposure controls; across a 
15-country programme at a major European bank, it has helped reduce end-of-day overdraft positions by 
30%, bring limit referrals to under 0.1% of payments and achieve 99.9% straight-through processing. 
 
Connecting Knowledge. Anticipating Change. 
As banking becomes increasingly AI-driven, Intellect’s MSOCK (Multidimensional Multilayer System of 
Connected Knowledge) creates an evidence-backed map of a bank’s technology estate, connecting 
business journeys, processes, policies and code to help people and AI understand the impact of change 
before it happens, and is currently being applied across 141 projects. Complementing this, IndustryFlow 
brings industry context into the equation, helping banks better understand corporate customers’ 
businesses and operating models to design services around their evolving needs. 
 
Commenting on the wins, Manish Maakan, Executive President & Group Chief 
Revenue Officer of Intellect Design Arena and Chief Executive Officer of 
Wholesale Banking, said, "We thank Euromoney and the distinguished jury for 
this recognition. These awards belong to our customers, colleagues and 
partners. Banks trust us to help them keep their promises to customers while 
undertaking 
the 
demanding 
work

modernisation. 
Bringing

management, payments and risk control together through eMACH.ai helps us 
serve that responsibility. As artificial intelligence enters banking, our focus is on 
connecting knowledge so people and AI can understand the consequences of 

 
 
 
 
change before making it. AI should make banks faster. It should never make them less certain. Being 
recognised by Euromoney as the World’s Best raises what our customers should expect of us, and we 
accept that responsibility with pride."

Intellect Design Arena Ltd is a global leader in AI-First, enterprise-grade financial technology, architected from first 
principles to deliver measurable business impact at scale. With three decades of domain expertise, Intellect 
delivers composable, intelligent platforms across Wholesale Banking, Consumer Banking, Central Banking, Wealth, 
Capital Markets, Treasury, Insurance and Digital Technology for Commerce. Applying First Principles Thinking and 
Design Thinking, Intellect has elementalised financial services into a finite set of Events, Microservices and APIs, 
enabling faster, modular transformation with predictable and measurable outcomes.

intelligent open finance platform; Purple Fabric, the world’s first Open Business Impact AI platform; and iTurmeric,

Intellect’s 8012 FinTech Design Center™, the world’s first Design Center dedicated to Design Thinking principles, 
underscores its commitment to continuous, outcome-driven innovation. Intellect serves over 500+ customers 
across 6s countries, supported by a global workforce of domain, solution and technology experts. For more

MEDIA RELEASE 
TACC Signs a non-binding MoU to Explore the Supply of fast-
charging anode materials for electric mobility 
 
• 
TACC signs a non-binding MoU with a global automotive OEM 
• 
A potential supply agreement could cover up to 30% of capacity from Phase 1 of 
20,000 MT 
 
TACC Limited has signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with a 
global automotive OEM to jointly explore the potential supply of TACC’s fast-charging 
anode materials for their electric vehicles. A potential future supply agreement could cover 
up to 30% of capacity from Phase 1 of TACC’s anode plant in Dewas.  The MoU sets the main 
framework and roadmap for further commercial negotiations between TACC and the OEM 
partner.  
  
The engagement highlights the growing global demand for high-performance anode 
technologies and the increasing focus on building resilient and diversified battery material 
supply chains. Under the MoU, TACC intends to advance the development and evaluation 
of its fast-charging anode materials for potential use in electric mobility. 
 
Commenting on the partnership, Riju Jhunjhunwala, Chairman, TACC Limited, said, "This 
MoU solidifies our vision to build India's advanced material capabilities for the future and 
provides a strong foundation for forging long-term, strategic partnerships across the 
global battery ecosystem to drive the energy transition." 
 
Ankur Khaitan, MD & CEO, TACC Limited, added, “This collaboration represents a significant 
step forward in our journey to build globally competitive battery materials from India. It 
underscores the potential of our advanced anode technology and reinforces our 
commitment to delivering innovative solutions that support the evolving needs of the 
global EV industry.”  
 
The MOU is marking a important milestone in TACC's growth journey and reinforcing its 
position in the global battery materials ecosystem.  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

CIN:  U31909MP2022PLC064004 
 
 
About TACC Limited 
TACC Limited, a subsidiary of HEG Advanced Materials, is at the forefront of India’s materials 
innovation, specializing in advanced carbon and graphite technologies. TACC is developing 
a broad range of carbon materials and advanced material solutions to meet the evolving 
needs of global energy storage and diverse industrial applications. In its first phase, TACC 
will produce 20,000 MT of anode active material (AAM) annually, with committed expansion 
of 44,000 MT catering to global cell manufacturers. In parrallel, the company is advancing 
commercial production of graphene targeting 500 MT per annum. These efforts are backed 
by strong in-house R&D and manufacturing capabilities, enabling TACC to serve a wide 
range of high-impact industrial applications. 
About HEG Advanced Materials Limited 
HEG Advanced Materials Limited, a part of the LNJ Bhilwara Group, is a new-age platform 
spanning advanced battery materials and graphene, with a strong manufacturing, R&D 
and innovation foundation, and is also engaged in the business of battery energy solutions 
and green power. Building on HEG’s 50+ years of expertise in graphitisation and 
manufacturing know-how, the platform is developing a large-scale anode materials 
business, alongside graphene and future material development, including silicon-based 
anodes. Its capabilities span research to revenue, from advanced research and product 
development to commercialisation, serving the evolving EV, BESS and energy storage 
ecosystem. The company is listed on BSE and NSE. 
 
***

News Release 
 
Suven Life Sciences to present “Masupirdine Phase-3 Baseline Demographic & Clinical 
Characteristics” and “Tenaclidine Phase-1 First-In-Human Safety, Tolerability, 
Pharmacokinetics” at the 19th Clinical Trials on Alzheimer’s Disease (CTAD-2026) 
Conference at Boston, USA. 
Hyderabad, India, 16-Nov-2026: Suven Life Sciences, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical 
company focused on developing innovative therapies for central nervous system (CNS) 
disorders, announced that it will present two scientific presentations highlighting the clinical 
progress of its investigational drug candidates, Masupirdine (SUVN-502) and Tenaclidine 
(SUVN-I6107), at the 19th Clinical Trials on Alzheimer’s Disease (CTAD) Conference, taking 
place during 16-19, November, 2026, at Boston, USA.  
CTAD is a global forum dedicated exclusively to Alzheimer’s disease clinical research, 
bringing together investigators, clinicians, industry scientists, and regulatory experts 
committed to advancing the field. CTAD fosters a collective scientific experience, encourages 
in-depth dialogue, and creates meaningful interactions across disciplines and offers an 
opportunity to engage with key opinion leaders, clinical trial specialists, regulatory 
representatives, and multidisciplinary research teams, while gaining insight into the latest 
advances shaping prevention and treatment strategies. 
Suven presentations at CTAD: 
P033: Masupirdine (SUVN-502), A Pure 5-HT6 Receptor Antagonist: Baseline 
Demographic and Clinical Characteristics of the Phase-3 Clinical Study Targeting Agitation 
in Patients with Dementia of Alzheimer’s Type - Baseline demographic and clinical 
characteristics of patients enrolled in the global Phase-3 study of Masupirdine will be 
presented. 
 
P066: Tenaclidine (SUVN-I6107), A Pure M1 Positive Allosteric Modulator First-in-Human 
Evaluation of Safety, Tolerability and Pharmacokinetics in Healthy Subjects - Outcome from 
the Phase-1 single ascending dose (SAD) and multiple ascending dose (MAD) studies of 
Tenaclidine (SUVN-I6107) in healthy subjects, including safety, tolerability and 
pharmacokinetics, as well as the effects of food, age and gender on its pharmacokinetic profile 
will be presented. 
"Completion of enrolment in the global Phase-3 Masupirdine AAD study marks an important 
milestone in the clinical development. Very glad to report the baseline characteristics are 
consistent with the published studies, representative of quality AD population with Agitation 
and no major safety concerns have been identified to date. We look forward to the topline 
results as scheduled in Q2-2027. We are very encouraged by the clinical findings for 
Tenaclidine, to move forward to the patient studies. The progress reflects our continued efforts 
to advance innovative therapeutic approaches addressing significant unmet needs in CNS 
disorders" said Mr. Venkat Jasti, Chairman and Managing Director, Suven Life Sciences. 
 
 

 
Suven Life Sciences Limited 
Registered Office: 8-2-334 I SDE Serene Chambers I 6th Floor Road No.5 I Avenue 7  
Banjara Hills I Hyderabad – 500 034 I Telangana I India I CIN: L24110TG1989PLC009713 
Tel: 91 40 2354 1142/ 1152 Email: info@suven.com website: www.suven.com 
 
About Suven Life Sciences: Suven Life Sciences Limited (Suven) is focused on the discovery 
and clinical development of innovative medicines that address unmet medical needs in CNS 
disorders. We have portfolio of advanced stage clinical candidates and research programs that 
are designed for CNS disorders such as Alzheimer’s disease (AD), Sleep disorders, Major 
depressive disorders (MDD), Parkinson’s disease (PD), Schizophrenia, Pain disorders, and 
Gastrointestinal disorders. Suven has 5 clinical stage assets across focus areas: Masupirdine 
(SUVN-502) for the treatment of agitation in patients with dementia of the Alzheimer's type 
(Global Phase-3 study ongoing, enrollment completed); Samelisant (SUVN-G3031) for 
excessive daytime sleepiness (EDS) in narcolepsy (Phase-2 study for EDS completed; pivotal 
Phase-3 AWAKE study for EDS is initiated and Phase-2 study for Cataplexy is in planning); 
Ropanicant (SUVN-911) for MDD (Open-label Phase-2a study completed; Double blind 
randomized Placebo controlled Phase-2b study completed and Phase-3 study is in planning); 
Usmarapride (SUVN-D4010) for cognitive disorders (Phase-2 study in planning), Tenaclidine 
(SUVN-I6107) for cognitive disorders (Phase-1 study is completed; Long term general toxicity 
and developmental toxicity studies in nonclinical models are in progress). In addition to these 
clinical assets, seven projects in research pipeline across multiple indications. Suven owns all 
intellectual property rights for its assets in all major world markets.  
For more information, please visit our website http://www.suven.com.

16th November 2026, Mumbai, India: Datamatics, a global Digital Operations, 
Technology, and Experiences company, has been recognised as a Major Contender in 
Everest Group’s Finance and Accounting Services (FAS) PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 
for the seventh consecutive year. 
Datamatics combines finance expertise, AI-powered automation, and proprietary 
finance transformation platform - FINATO, to help enterprises transform finance 
operations, improve efficiency, optimise costs, and strengthen financial control. Its 
integrated approach brings together technology and finance professionals to deliver 
measurable business benefits across the finance value chain. 
Key strengths of Datamatics highlighted in the Everest Group FAS PEAK Matrix® 
Assessment 2026 include: 
 
Technology-Led Finance Transformation: End-to-end F&A services across 
accounts payable (AP), accounts receivable (AR), general accounting, taxation, 
and financial planning and analysis (FP&A), supported by FINATO, its finance 
orchestration platform. 
 
AI-Powered Finance Operations: Advancing FINATO’s capabilities towards 
agentic AI orchestration across targeted procure-to-pay (P2P) and order-to-
cash (O2C) use cases, including invoice processing, general ledger coding, 
collections, and cash application. 
 
Integrated Technology Ecosystem: Combining FINATO with proprietary 
solutions such as TruBot, TruBI, TruAI, and TruCap+ to enable intelligent 
automation, data-driven decision-making, and greater process efficiency. 
 
Industry-Specific Solutions: Delivering tailored F&A solutions for industries 
including manufacturing, logistics, energy, utilities, hi-tech, telecom, and 
business services, aligned with sector-specific processes and requirements. 
 
Flexible, Value-Driven Engagements: Offering technology-led transformation 
supported by flexible commercial models, including gainsharing arrangements, 
to align service delivery with business value. 

 
Vignesh Kannan, Vice President, Everest Group, said, “Datamatics has differentiated 
its F&A proposition as a technology-led modular offering, combining managed services 
with productized automation, industry-contextualized solutioning, and flexible 
commercial constructs. FINATO is evolving in a modular agentic orchestration across 
targeted P2P and O2C use cases, enabling buyers to adopt automation and 
transformation capabilities incrementally. Its preconfigured integrations and rapid 
transition methodologies - strengthens its relevance for buyers seeking accessible, value-
oriented finance transformation. This reinforces its position as a Major Contender in 
Everest Group’s 2026 Integrated Finance and Accounting Services (FAS) PEAK Matrix® 
Assessment.” 
Rahul Kanodia, Vice Chairman & CEO, Datamatics, said, “Our recognition by Everest 
Group for the seventh consecutive year reflects our deep F&A expertise and AI-
powered capabilities. By bringing AI, automation, and finance professionals together, 
we help enterprises enhance efficiency, optimise costs, and strengthen financial control 
while delivering measurable business outcomes.”

Datamatics Recognised as a Major Contender in Everest 
Group’s Finance and Accounting Services PEAK Matrix® 
Assessment for the Seventh Consecutive Year 
 
16th November 2026, Mumbai, India: Datamatics, a global Digital Operations, 
Technology, and Experiences company, has been recognised as a Major Contender in 
Everest Group’s Finance and Accounting Services (FAS) PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 
for the seventh consecutive year. 
Datamatics combines finance expertise, AI-powered automation, and proprietary 
finance transformation platform - FINATO, to help enterprises transform finance 
operations, improve efficiency, optimise costs, and strengthen financial control. Its 
integrated approach brings together technology and finance professionals to deliver 
measurable business benefits across the finance value chain. 
Key strengths of Datamatics highlighted in the Everest Group FAS PEAK Matrix® 
Assessment 2026 include: 
 
Technology-Led Finance Transformation: End-to-end F&A services across 
accounts payable (AP), accounts receivable (AR), general accounting, taxation, 
and financial planning and analysis (FP&A), supported by FINATO, its finance 
orchestration platform. 
 
AI-Powered Finance Operations: Advancing FINATO’s capabilities towards 
agentic AI orchestration across targeted procure-to-pay (P2P) and order-to-
cash (O2C) use cases, including invoice processing, general ledger coding, 
collections, and cash application. 
 
Integrated Technology Ecosystem: Combining FINATO with proprietary 
solutions such as TruBot, TruBI, TruAI, and TruCap+ to enable intelligent 
automation, data-driven decision-making, and greater process efficiency. 
 
Industry-Specific Solutions: Delivering tailored F&A solutions for industries 
including manufacturing, logistics, energy, utilities, hi-tech, telecom, and 
business services, aligned with sector-specific processes and requirements. 
 
Flexible, Value-Driven Engagements: Offering technology-led transformation 
supported by flexible commercial models, including gainsharing arrangements, 
to align service delivery with business value. 

 
Vignesh Kannan, Vice President, Everest Group, said, “Datamatics has differentiated 
its F&A proposition as a technology-led modular offering, combining managed services 
with productized automation, industry-contextualized solutioning, and flexible 
commercial constructs. FINATO is evolving in a modular agentic orchestration across 
targeted P2P and O2C use cases, enabling buyers to adopt automation and 
transformation capabilities incrementally. Its preconfigured integrations and rapid 
transition methodologies - strengthens its relevance for buyers seeking accessible, value-
oriented finance transformation. This reinforces its position as a Major Contender in 
Everest Group’s 2026 Integrated Finance and Accounting Services (FAS) PEAK Matrix® 
Assessment.” 
Rahul Kanodia, Vice Chairman & CEO, Datamatics, said, “Our recognition by Everest 
Group for the seventh consecutive year reflects our deep F&A expertise and AI-
powered capabilities. By bringing AI, automation, and finance professionals together, 
we help enterprises enhance efficiency, optimise costs, and strengthen financial control 
while delivering measurable business outcomes.” 
To access the complete report, click here: https://www.datamatics.com/everest-
group-finance-and-accounting-services-peak-matrix-assessment-2026

Everest Group is a leading global research firm helping business leaders make 
confident decisions. Everest Group's PEAK Matrix® assessments provide the analysis 
and insights enterprises need to make critical selection decisions about global services 
providers, locations, and products and solutions within various market segments. 
Likewise, providers of these services, products, and solutions, look to the PEAK Matrix® 
to gauge and calibrate their offerings against others in the industry or market. Find 
further details and in-depth content at www.everestgrp.com.  

 
About Datamatics: 
Datamatics delivers measurable business benefits to hundreds of global enterprises 
by managing and transforming their Information Technology, Finance, and Business 
Operations. With an AI-first approach, Datamatics combines technology innovation, 
deep domain expertise, and operational excellence to help enterprises enhance 
business performance, drive operational efficiency, and accelerate digital 
transformation. 
Datamatics has evolved into a trusted partner for global enterprises across BFSI,

Hero Cycles Selects Capillary to Power Loyalty Across Its 3,000+ Dealer 
Network  
 
Subtext: Hero Cycles has already launched the program with 50 dealers, with plans to scale the 
initiative across its nationwide network.  
  
New Delhi, India – Hero Cycles, India’s largest bicycle manufacturer, has selected Capillary 
Technologies to power a new dealer loyalty program across its network of more than 3,000 dealers 
nationwide. The program has already been launched with 50 dealers, marking the first phase of 
a broader rollout across Hero Cycles’ dealer ecosystem. The initiative will help Hero Cycles 
strengthen dealer relationships through a more unified, data-driven approach to rewards, 
engagement and performance.  
With one of the largest dealer networks in the Indian bicycle industry, Hero Cycles is looking to 
build on its existing incentive initiatives with deeper channel insights, more personalised rewards 
and sustained engagement mechanisms. The program is designed to strengthen dealer 
preference and participation while supporting long-term business growth across its portfolio.  
Capillary’s platform will be integrated with Hero Cycles’ existing BIZOM app, creating a seamless 
experience for dealers. The program will recognise and reward a range of activities, including sell-

out performance, training participation, store branding and cross-category selling. Through 
personalised rewards, gamified experiences and greater visibility into dealer engagement, Hero 
Cycles aims to build a more structured and continuous relationship with its dealer network.  
Aditya Munjal, CEO at Hero Cycles, shared: “Our dealer network remains at the heart of our 
business strategy. As Hero Cycles continues to grow and evolve, we see an opportunity to further 
strengthen dealer relationships through a more structured and engaging loyalty approach. With 
the program now live with our first 50 dealers, we are seeing the foundation of a more rewarding 
experience for our partners, while creating greater opportunities for collaboration, participation 
and business growth across the network.”  
Sumit Kumar, President - India, Middle East & Africa at Capillary Technologies, commented: “Hero 
Cycles is an iconic Indian brand with one of the most extensive distribution networks in the country. 
With our experience helping leading brands build stronger customer and partner relationships at 
scale, we see this partnership as an opportunity to transform every dealer interaction into a driver 
of preference, performance, and long-term value.”  
For Capillary Technologies, the partnership expands its presence in B2B and channel loyalty, 
applying its experience in large-scale loyalty and engagement programs to India’s manufacturing 
and distribution ecosystem. As businesses increasingly look beyond transactional incentives to 
build deeper relationships with their partners and channels, the initiative reflects a growing shift 
toward more personalised, data-driven approaches to dealer engagement.  
About Hero Cycles   
Hero Cycles is one of India's leading bicycle manufacturers and the oldest entity within the Hero 
Group, with manufacturing in Ludhiana and corporate operations in New Delhi. Spanning bicycles, 
spares, and accessories, Hero Cycles has built one of the most extensive B2B distribution 
networks in the country, serving markets from metros to the remotest towns across India. Know 
more at www.herocycles.com   
  
About Capillary Technologies  
Founded in 2012, Capillary Technologies is a global leader in AI-powered customer loyalty and 
engagement solutions. The platform helps brands deliver personalised, omnichannel experiences 
that drive customer retention and business growth. Supporting 100+ loyalty programmes in over 
46 countries, Capillary powers loyalty for enterprise brands. Capillary’s SaaS platform delivers 
loyalty experiences for 1.9 billion+ consumers and is recognised by leading industry analysts. 
Know more at www.capillarytech.com
